source_contributions.scope: Non-obsolete cellular_component terms with between 2 and 1000 annotated human genes (inclusive), after propagation through is_a and part_of relationships and removal of genes with NOT annotations to the term.
source_contributions.description: GO supplies term labels, definitions, alternative names and identifiers, and external cross-references. Gene annotations used to select terms come from NCBI gene2go and include direct and propagated annotations. Only associations to human Gene nodes present in SPOKE are retained. The GO hierarchy is not exposed as edges in SPOKE.
